hotels.title: Portugal: Algarve Luxury Retreat on Private Lake with Vilamoura Marina Views & Floating Restaurant
hotels.description: Set on a private lake with views across the Vilamoura marina, Domes Lake Algarve is a five-star retreat where the natural world blends with true luxury. Spend days between the pools and Praia de Falesia - one of Europe's most celebrated beaches, with direct access from the hotel plus dedicated loungers reserved for resort guests. Unwind at Soma Spa, where treatments draw on ancient Greek traditions alongside hammam rituals and wellness experiences. Five world-class golf courses are easily accessible via a complimentary shuttle. Dining is a highlight, spanning six distinct concepts: from Greek and Portuguese fusion at Gustatio and wood-fired Italian at Antonino's, to the lakeside floating experience at Blend Nikkei and Wine. Round off the evening at Migratory Bar, a champagne and cocktail lounge where every drink tells its own story.

hotels.vendor_name: Wyndham Grand Algarve | Quinta do lago
hotels.title: Portugal: Award-Winning Algarve Luxury Suites near Beach & Golf Courses with EUR100 Spa Credit
hotels.description: Soak up the allure of Portugal's sun-kissed southern coast with a stay at this sophisticated award-winning resort in the heart of Quinta do Lago. The all-suite property offers an idyllic escape with easy access to the Algarve's world-renowned golf courses and Ria Formosa Natural Park, plus a private nature path leading directly to Quinta do Lago Beach. Spend your time savouring authentic Portuguese delicacies across the hotel's two onsite restaurants and sipping epic cocktails at the Grand Bar & Lounge. Cool off by the pool or book into the adults-only Grand Spa for an afternoon of massages, body scrubs and facials while the little ones are kept occupied at the kids' club. Explore Faro's picturesque coastline (teeming with mysterious sea caves), surf the gorgeous swells, tee off at one of the nearby championship golf courses or kick back and relax in the serenity of the resort - it's your holiday, your way.
